DevPULSE Labs · ColdLight matrix · type pool review

Red-mark the pool.

Eight ancestral families, ~20 faces each, ~120 unique once overlaps are counted. Every face is OFL. A face carries a class; an ancestor rules on classes — so nothing here is hand-assigned and a new face is classified once, not eight times.

How to mark

Click any face to cut it. Click again to keep. Pick an option on each ruling below. Then hit Copy decisions at the bottom and paste the result back to me — I'll lock the pool from it. Nothing is fetched or written until you do.

What's real on this page

Faces tagged in repo are the 13 you already have — those are rendering in their actual letterforms. Faces tagged fetch are proposals: they exist and are free, but they are not in the repo yet, so they render in the system face and you're judging the name and the fit, not the shape. Colours everywhere are computed from your real OKLCH ramps.
